_comment: Devnet deploy config. Copy to a path outside the repo (it names real wallets), fill every <FILL: ...>, and pass it with --config. Never put a key in it: addresses only. Two Squads v4 multisigs (spec §12 Q15): `squads` is the admin multisig (its vault is VaultConfig.admin, time lock >= 5 min) and `upgradeSquads` holds the program upgrade authority (time lock >= 1 h). The scripts derive each vault from multisig + vaultIndex and require it to equal `admin` / `upgradeAuthority`; deploy.ts and verify.ts require each multisig to be owned by the Squads v4 program, autonomous, with exactly these members (each able to vote), exactly this threshold and a time lock at or above the floor. Values without <FILL> are the locked devnet values (c = 0.10, ADR 0016; fee take 2000); verify.ts checks them on-chain.

squads._comment: Admin multisig: 2-of-2, time lock >= 300 s on devnet (24 h on the real pilot).

upgradeSquads._comment: Upgrade multisig: same members, 2-of-2, time lock >= 3600 s on devnet (7 days on the real pilot).

admin: <FILL: the admin multisig's vault (index above): VaultConfig.admin>
upgradeAuthority: <FILL: the upgrade multisig's vault (index above): the program upgrade authority>
operator: <FILL: operator pubkey — the KMS key from mutav-app, or a devnet test key>
mutavCapitalWallet: <FILL: MUTAV capital wallet (owns neither money account)>
treasuryAccount: <FILL: BRS token account receiving MUTAV's fee take>
paymentsAccount: <FILL: BRS token account receiving claim payments>

caps._comment: BRS base units (6 dp). Sized for c = 0.10 (ADR 0016): R$300k reserve, R$40k per guarantee, R$10k / R$20k claim payments per call / per 31 days (ADR 0019), requests R$1k–R$100k. maxNavMoveBps is 10000 (100%) on devnet on purpose: the guard nets out guarantee fees and swept income per share (ADR 0017), but a claim provision or payment against a small demo reserve is a real NAV move and would trip it and halt fulfilment. If it trips, the admin clears it with clear_fulfil_halt (ADR 0015). Lower it for the real pilot.

allowlist: <FILL: MUTAV capital wallet, plus any devnet investor wallets>
